## In-Depth Marketing Psychology & Consumer Behavior

11. **What Makes People Say “Yes” in Marketing? (Seth Godin)**  
    - [Seth Godin on Persuasion](https://seths.blog/what-makes-people-say-yes/)  
    *An exploration of the psychology behind consent and persuasion in marketing.*

12. **Why Urgency Drives Conversions (FOMO) (Gary Vaynerchuk)**  
    - [Gary Vaynerchuk on FOMO](https://www.garyvaynerchuk.com/fomo-marketing/)  
    *An article on creating urgency in marketing to encourage immediate action.*

13. **How People Justify Emotional Purchases with Logic (Dan Kennedy)**  
    - [Dan Kennedy on Emotional Marketing](https://dankennedy.com/emotional-vs-logical-buying/)  
    *Insights into the interplay of emotion and reason in consumer decision-making.*

14. **Price Anchoring & the Power of Contrast (Russell Brunson)**  
    - [Russell Brunson on Pricing Strategies](https://russellbrunson.com/price-anchoring/)  
    *Explains how setting a high initial price makes subsequent options appear more attractive.*

15. **The Psychology Behind “FREE” (Alex Hormozi)**
